what_it_does: This paper accelerates Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for large language models. RAG works by searching a knowledge base to find relevant documents, then using those documents to improve the language model's response. The paper shows that exact search methods, which find the perfect matches, can actually be faster end-to-end than approximate methods because they select fewer, higher-quality documents, reducing the work for the language model. The paper proposes hardware and system-level acceleration techniques optimized for exact nearest-neighbor search in RAG pipelines.
